fc.out.success.title: ★ Minimum success — PDF received
fc.out.success.body:
A PDF arrives on the messenger. Filename: 'family_certificate(so_annoying).pdf'
Manager Park: "Fine." (No praise. Payroll closed.)
Conversion review: small plus.

Minji's status message changed: 'HR is scary'. That's tomorrow's problem.
fc.out.ambiguous.title: ◆ Ambiguous — it showed up, kind of
fc.out.ambiguous.body:
The form arrives at 18:40. Forty minutes after close. "sowwy I'm late~"
The allowance rolls over to next month.
Manager Park: "I said before close. Intern time sense… cute?"
Conversion review: plus and minus cancel. Side-eye remains.
fc.out.escalate.title: ✗✗ Manager escalates
fc.out.escalate.body:
Manager Park walked over to Minji's desk herself. The whole office went quiet.
The form arrived in three minutes.
Manager: "Three minutes. Why couldn't the intern do it all day? This comes up at your conversion."

The manager got the form. Your face went with it.
fc.out.fail.title: ✗ Failure — I'll do it tomorrow~
fc.out.fail.body:
Minji: "tmr~ heading out bye" (status: offline)
Payroll unprocessed. Manager Park's stare is colder than the checklist.
A hole in the conversion review.
fc.interrupt.pos.say: Hang on— handling this now might be better.
fc.interrupt.neg.reply: Do not cut me off;; that is rude.
